#Fig 3
#Beta diversity- age group
```{r}
#Beta diversity-age group
# 
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq), check.names = FALSE)

# meta <- meta %>%
#   mutate(age_group = ifelse(age_MBC_dx < 50, "<50", "≥50"))
# 
# sample_data(physeq) <- meta

#  Define grouping variable
group_col <- "age_group"

#  Color palette
age_colors <- c("<50" = "#D5A021", ">=50" = "#6C4E09")

#  Check groups
unique(sample_data(physeq)[[group_col]])

#  Compute Bray–Curtis distance
dist_bc <- phyloseq::distance(physeq, method = "bray")

#  PCoA ordination
ord_pcoa <- ordinate(physeq, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_bc)

#  Extract % variance explained by each axis
eig_vals <- ord_pcoa$values$Eigenvalues
axis_var <- eig_vals / sum(eig_vals) * 100
x_lab <- paste0("PCoA1 (", round(axis_var[1], 2), "%)")
y_lab <- paste0("PCoA2 (", round(axis_var[2], 2), "%)")

#  PERMANOVA test
set.seed(123)
meta_df <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq))
adonis_res <- adonis2(dist_bc ~ age_group, data = meta_df, permutations = 999)

#  Extract R² and p-value
R2_value <- adonis_res$R2[1]
p_value  <- adonis_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]

# Format nicely for annotation
R2_label <- paste0("R² = ", sprintf("%.3f", R2_value))
p_label  <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value)))
annot_text <- paste("PERMANOVA", R2_label, p_label, sep = ", ")

print(adonis_res)
cat("Extracted values:", annot_text, "\n")

#  Plot PCoA
p_pcoa_age <- plot_ordination(physeq, ord_pcoa, color = group_col) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = !!sym(group_col)), type = "t", linetype = 2) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  scale_color_manual(values = age_colors) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  ggtitle("Age at MBC diagnosis") +
   xlab(x_lab) + 
  ylab(y_lab) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
           label = annot_text,
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
           size = 4.5)+
  theme(
  legend.position = c(0.98, 0.05),
  legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
  legend.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.6), color = NA)
)

#  Display and save
p_pcoa_age
ggsave("../Output/Plots/p_PCoA_BrayCurtis_age_group.pdf",
       p_pcoa_age, width = 8, height = 6)
```

#Beta diversity- CTC group
```{r}
#Beta diversity-ctc group
# 
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq), check.names = FALSE)

meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    ctc2 = case_when(
      CTC_count_cat %in% c("0", "0-5") ~ "0–5",
      CTC_count_cat %in% c(">5")  ~ ">5",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ctc2))

keep_samples <- rownames(meta)

physeq_filtered <- prune_samples(keep_samples, physeq)
sample_data(physeq_filtered)$ctc2 <- meta$ctc2
stopifnot(all(rownames(meta) == sample_names(physeq_filtered)))

dist_bc <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_filtered, method = "bray")
# PERMANOVA
# ============================================================
set.seed(123)
adonis_res <- adonis2(dist_bc ~ ctc2, data = meta, permutations = 999)


# get R2 and p
R2_value <- adonis_res$R2[1]
p_value  <- adonis_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]

R2_label <- paste0("R² = ", sprintf("%.3f", R2_value))
p_label  <- paste0("p = ",
                   ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value))
                   )

annot_text <- paste("PERMANOVA", R2_label, p_label, sep = ", ")


#  Define grouping variable
group_col <- "ctc2"

#  Color palette
ctc_colors <- c("0–5" = "#F7A280",
             ">5" = "#B33C1E")

#  PCoA ordination
ord_pcoa <- ordinate(physeq_filtered, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_bc)

eig_vals <- ord_pcoa$values$Eigenvalues
axis_var <- eig_vals / sum(eig_vals) * 100

x_lab <- paste0("PCoA1 (", round(axis_var[1], 2), "%)")
y_lab <- paste0("PCoA2 (", round(axis_var[2], 2), "%)")


#  Plot PCoA
p_pcoa_ctc <- plot_ordination(physeq_filtered, ord_pcoa, color = group_col) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = !!sym(group_col)), type = "t", linetype = 2) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ctc_colors) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    #legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  ggtitle("CTCs categories") +
   xlab(x_lab) + 
  ylab(y_lab) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
           label = annot_text,
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
           size = 4.5)+
  theme(
  legend.position = c(0.98, 0.05),
  legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
  legend.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.6), color = NA)
)

#  Display and save
p_pcoa_ctc
ggsave("../Output/Plots/p_PCoA_BrayCurtis_ctc_group.pdf",
       p_pcoa_ctc, width = 8, height = 6)
```
